0: Marcia Ingram Jones Smoke ( born July 18 , 1941 ) is an American sprint canoer .
1: She competed at the 1964 , 1968 and 1972 Olympics and won a bronze medal in the K-1 500 m event in 1964 .
2: A native of Oklahoma City , Oklahoma , Jones graduated from Michigan State University .
3: She won three gold medals at the 1967 Pan American Games and a record 35 national championships and 24 North American championships .
4: Her husband , William Smoke , finished fourth in the second repechage event of the K-4 1000 m at the 1964 Summer Olympics in Tokyo .
5: Jones ' son , Jeff , finished seventh in the K-2 1000 m semifinal at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens .
6: Her sister , the late Sperry Rademaker , finished seventh in the K-2 500 m event at the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico City .

0: Paul Marie Bonaparte ( February 19 , 1809 in Canino – September 7 , 1827 in Nafplio ) fought in the Greek War of Independence .
1: Paul Marie Bonaparte was the third child of Lucien Bonaparte and Alexandrine de Bleschamp .
2: He studied at the University of Bologna .
3: In March 1827 he secretly left the city , and under an assumed name , went to Greece to take part in the Greek War of Independence .
4: Arriving first at the Ionian Islands , Bonaparte was welcomed August 24 at Poros by the British Admiral Cochrane , who was entrusted with command of the Greek fleet .
5: Bonaparte served on the flagship frigate Hellas , which after a series of unsuccessful operations stood off in the strait of the island Spetses .
6: On 6 September 1827 , on board the Hellas , Bonaparte was mortally wounded while cleaning his own gun and died the day after .
7: After the end of the war in 1832 , Bonaparte was buried in a mausoleum on the island of Sphacteria , close to the French sailors who fell in the Battle of Navarino .
